prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: David Fincher’s most recently released feature film was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**. Britney Spears’s first feature-film appearance was in **_Longshot_ (2001)**, by which time Fincher’s next film, **_Panic Room_**, had not yet been released.
